articles.title: Bitcoin holds near $80,000 as oil retreats and the Fed decision looms
articles.snippet: Bitcoin was little changed near $80,400 since midnight UTC while the DeFi index was the only CoinDesk index to gain, with the Fed due to decide on Wednesday.

articles.title: Block's new voice AI sounds eerily human, sparking awe and scam fears
articles.snippet: Reactions split between amazement at how human it sounds and fears it could fuel scams and deception, with CZ eyeing uses in children’s education.

articles.title: PHP flaw shows AI ‘vulnerability apocalypse’ is on schedule: Immunefi CEO
articles.snippet: Mitchell Amador warned internet users that websites could remain compromised for weeks, particularly smaller websites slower to adopt the emergency upgrades.

articles.title: Why Prediction Markets Got the Brazilian Election So Wrong
articles.snippet: Experts say Brazil's prediction market ban left the odds in the hands of traders with little knowledge about the election.

articles.title: SpaceX Locks Up $40 Billion for AI Chips as Musk Warns Most Neoclouds Will Die
articles.snippet: Elon Musk says SpaceX closed a $40 billion chip deal with Apollo while lenders shut the door on smaller AI cloud firms, a split that could decide who controls computing.
